changes: Corrected the pinned-store identity assertion: the first version required class metadata the pinned runtime does not record, so it rejected a valid P01 run (P01-A1).
Added an all-success lifecycle-history check (six transitions per successful request).
Added preservation and corrected re-verification of P01-A1 under prior-attempts/, renamed the repeated pilot P01-A2, and recorded the 16 protocol IDs.
Added a gate that copies the completed upstream suite report and requires pinned/indexed/bounded-6000 to pass 146 tests and bounded/1 to fail 2 as the positive control.
